purpose: Every company covered under rule 2 shall file a half yearly return with the Registrar in Form NDH-3.
when: Within thirty days from the conclusion of each half year
steps: Prepare the half yearly return in Form NDH-3.
Get the form duly certified by a company secretary in practice, chartered accountant in practice, or cost accountant in practice.
Pay the required fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
File Form NDH-3 with the Registrar.
checklist: Verify the company is covered under rule 2.
Ensure the return is for the correct half year period.
Obtain certification from a practicing company secretary, chartered accountant, or cost accountant.
Arrange the fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
watch: Ensure the filing is done within thirty days from the conclusion of each half year.
